title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
银行外，乔治.詹特利手拿扩音器，一连喊话了三遍。在连续三次都没人应答后，他朝身旁的FBI助理主管威廉.斯蒂芬摇了摇头，下达了开火的指令。轰！轰隆！！！一声巨响和爆炸，有着两百多年历史的老牌银行被焰火吞没，门口仿罗马风格的大理石柱折断成数截，碎石像下雨一样四处飞溅。与此同时，银行地下也响起数道沉闷的爆炸。以银行地下这段下水管道为中心，通往四周的地下管道全部被炸塌。堵死了卢克.邓肯最后的退路。“卢克表哥……”摇晃的银行保险库里，米娜有些害怕和不知所措。她再聪明毕竟也只是个十七岁的未成年少女。像现在这种只在电影里看到过的战争场面，已经超出了她能处理的范围。她既担心刚相认的表哥等下会被抓走，也担心被抓的弟弟罗伯特还有其他几位同伴。脑子乱哄哄的，完全无法再像平时那样集中精力，冷静思考。“别怕，米娜。”宽大的手掌落在了她头上。就像小时候母亲安慰在学校里被欺负了的自己那样，卢克温声道：“你和罗伯特都不会有事的，我保证！！！”说话间，卢克声音越来越粗犷。他第一次完全放开了对体内那股充满兽性的力量的控制。轰！！！瞬时间，无法用言语形容的狂暴力量从他心脏位置爆发，充斥于四肢百骸。他的体型如同吹气球般膨胀起来，两米，三米，四米…..一直到接近六米，银行保险库整个房间都快装不下时，才将将停下。并且十分反常理的，随着体型激增，他全身骨骼、肌肉、皮肤密度不降反升。如果现在有人给他称量体重的话，会惊奇地发现，卢克现在的体重甚至超过了一头成年亚洲象，达到了惊人的十吨。米娜抬头仰望着面前这个巨人，精致脸蛋上满是不敢置信之色。“米娜，不用怕，待在这里……”

巨人低头俯视着她，将手里那块碧绿色的青铜面具小心放进了她怀里，眼中属于人类的理智逐渐被兽性取代。轰隆！！最后在银行又一次承受坦克炮击，建筑剧烈晃动时。巨人抬起头来，抱起一根断裂倒塌的石柱，气势凶猛地冲了出去。咚！咚！咚！！！地面震动如同擂鼓。当一个身高六米有余，体重超过十吨的巨人手持石柱冲出来时，带给在场所有人的震撼和冲击力是难以想象的。那种感觉，仿佛是他们瞬间从现代穿越到荷马史诗中记载的故事里，奥德修斯遭遇了独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯，他们也遭遇到了同样的怪物。“沃特法克，詹姆斯那个狗屎只跟我们说了，我们要对付的是一个变异人，可没跟我们说，这个变异人比我们的坦克还大！！”银行外，有国民警卫队的士兵忍不住爆出了粗口。被这巨人急冲而来的巨大压力，吓得他肾上激素飙升，忍不住扣动了手中步枪的板机。砰砰！！！这一声枪声仿佛是某种信号。在场士兵们无论是驾驶坦克还是装甲车的，又或者埋伏在制高点的狙击手，都不用长官下令，纷纷对巨人发动了攻击。霎那间，枪声比暴雨还要密集。就算是再怎么强壮的地球生物，也会被这片现代科技形成的金属风暴撕成碎片。但卢克.邓肯除外。他身上的能力可不是来自地球。那些普通的步枪子弹打在他身上，基本上跟挠痒痒没什么区别。12.7毫米口径的狙击子弹也只有攻击他眼睛等要害，才会对卢克造成一定威胁。只有装甲车还有坦克上面装载的大口径主炮，反坦克武器，才能对他真正造成伤害。但理智被兽性所取代，可不意味着卢克会笨到站在那任他们打。恰恰相反。他现在的直觉敏锐到可怕。往往那些大口径主炮还有反坦克武器还没有瞄准他，他已经双腿蓄力跳跃到另外一处，挥舞着手中石柱，对着那些士兵还有坦克装甲车一顿乱砸。
content_en:
Outside the bank, George Gentry held a loudspeaker and shouted three times in a row.After no one responded three times in a row, he shook his head at FBI Assistant Director William Stephens beside him and gave the order to fire.boom!Boom!!!There was a loud noise and explosion, and the old bank with a history of more than 200 years was engulfed by fireworks. The imitation Roman-style marble columns at the door were broken into several pieces, and rubble was splashed everywhere like rain.At the same time, several dull explosions also sounded underground in the bank.Centering on the sewer pipe underground of the bank, all the underground pipes leading to the surrounding areas were blown down.Blocking Luke Duncan's last escape route."Cousin Luke..." In the swaying bank vault, Mina was a little scared and at a loss.No matter how smart she is, she is still just a seventeen-year-old underage girl.War scenes like this, which she had only seen in movies, were beyond her ability to handle.She was worried that her cousin, whom she had just met, would be arrested later, and she was also worried that her younger brother Robert and several other companions would be arrested.My mind was in chaos, and I could no longer concentrate and think calmly as usual."Don't be afraid, Mina." A broad palm fell on her head.Just like his mother comforted him when he was bullied in school when he was a child, Luke said gently: "Both you and Robert will be fine, I promise!!!" As he spoke, Luke's voice became more and more rough.For the first time, he completely let go of the control of the animalistic power in his body.boom!!!In an instant, a violent force that could not be described in words erupted from his heart, filling his limbs and bones.His body expanded like a balloon, two meters, three meters, four meters... until it was close to six meters, and the entire room of the bank vault could hardly be filled, and he would stop.And very unnaturally, as his body size increased, the density of his bones, muscles, and skin increased instead of decreasing.If someone were to weigh him now, they would be surprised to find that Luke now weighs even more than an adult Asian elephant, reaching an astonishing ten tons.Mina looked up at the giant in front of her, her delicate face full of disbelief."Mina, don't be afraid, stay here..."

The giant lowered his head to look down at her, and carefully put the green bronze mask in his hand into her arms. The human reason in his eyes was gradually replaced by animal nature.Boom!!Finally, when the bank suffered another tank shelling, the building shook violently.The giant raised his head, picked up a broken and collapsed stone pillar, and rushed out fiercely.Boom!Boom!Boom!!!The ground shook like a drum.When a giant over six meters tall and weighing over ten tons rushed out holding a stone pillar, the shock and impact it brought to everyone present was unimaginable.It felt as if they had instantly traveled from modern times to the story recorded in Homer's epic poem. Odysseus encountered the Cyclops Polyphemus, and they also encountered the same monster."Walter Falk, that piece of shit James only told us that what we were dealing with was a mutant, but he didn't tell us that this mutant was bigger than our tank!!" Outside the bank, a National Guard soldier couldn't help but swear.The huge pressure from the giant charging towards him frightened him so much that his adrenal hormones surged, and he couldn't help but pull the trigger of the rifle in his hand.Bang bang!!!This gunshot seemed to be some kind of signal.The soldiers present, whether they were driving tanks or armored vehicles, or snipers ambushing at the commanding heights, launched attacks on the giants without any orders from their superiors.In an instant, the sound of gunfire was denser than the heavy rain.No matter how strong the Earth's creatures are, they will be torn into pieces by this metal storm formed by modern technology.Except Luke Duncan.His abilities do not come from the earth.Those ordinary rifle bullets hitting him were basically the same as tickling him.A 12.7 mm caliber sniper bullet would only pose a certain threat to Luke if it hits his eyes and other vital points.Only the large-caliber main guns and anti-tank weapons mounted on armored vehicles and tanks can really cause harm to him.But reason being replaced by animality doesn't mean Luke will be stupid enough to stand there and let them beat him.Quite the opposite.His intuition is now frighteningly sharp.Often before those large-caliber main guns and anti-tank weapons were aimed at him, he had already charged up his legs and jumped to another place, waving the stone pillar in his hand and smashing it at the soldiers and tanks and armored vehicles.
